message.content: On September 16th, 2026, WolfgangSchulz suggested incorporating improvisational solos into their practice sessions. This idea was proposed with the intention of making the sessions more fun and creative, challenging musicians to grow as artists, and allowing them to showcase individual talents. LiHua agreed enthusiastically, noting that improvisation would definitely make their sessions more enjoyable and creative. They proposed going with the flow during the improvisations, suggesting that spontaneity and flexibility would be key to enhancing the practice sessions. LiHua and WolfgangSchulz both expressed excitement about the prospect of jamming without a strict plan, which they believed would keep things exciting and engaging.
